d:
Sexy fox goddess finds her future husband. This seems like something that would've been translated already, and I thought I did see a TL of it, but that was the Korean version. I looked all over and couldn't find an English TL of it, so I had to step in.

Yes, the first two pages seem out of order, but I'm fairly sure they aren't. I think they're just a proof of concept kind of thing that the artist drew before deciding to draw out the full manga part.

For those wondering, yes, I'm still working on my next trap release as well, but it's going to be a couple days before it's done. This was something I worked on a little bit at a time when I had some free time over the last month or so.

Happy fapping!
